svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two 50 x 117.5 mm blanks of 3 mm plate; round the corners 3 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Measure down from the top edge and sideways from the centre line:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rail bolts 6.5 mm at 12.5 down, 12 each side of centre;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: axle hole 20 mm at 77.5 down, centred;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bearing bolts 6.5 mm at 49.5 and 105.5 down, centred.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Chain-side plate only: drill 4.2 mm and tap M5 at 107 down, 17 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: forward of centre, for the guard spacer screw.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the pair clamped together for the shared holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: on the outside face of each rail, top edge flush with the rail top,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centred on the drive axle 80 mm behind the rail front; the axle

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bearing bolts flat to its inside face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the axle hole lines up across both plates (sight through).
